raw_segments.text: Ayachimo, O dearest soul, your cause doth strike my heart with pity that doth make me
A lady so fair, and fastened to an emperor, would make the greatstee king double, to be
partnered with tomboy's herd with that self-exhibition which your own coffers yield, with diseased
ventures that play with all infirmities for gold which rottenness can lend nature.
Such boiled stuff as well might poison poison.
Or she that bore you as no queen, and you recoil from your great stock.
